preregistered_structural_law.event: At the frozen anchor lattice, a completed M5 close is extreme when its z-score against the trailing 12 completed closes (including itself) is at least +2 or at most -2.
preregistered_structural_law.zero_scale_policy: No event is emitted when the 12-close population standard deviation is zero.
preregistered_structural_law.anchor_lattice: Within each exact-contiguous M5 segment, evaluate index 11 and then every 12 observed bars; restart at index 11 after each missing or off-cadence interval.
preregistered_structural_law.outcome: At t+12 completed M5 bars, calculate the absolute distance of the close from the event-time rolling mean. The standardized absolute-distance contraction is (abs(close_t - center_t) - abs(close_t+12 - center_t)) / scale_t. Positive values indicate movement toward the frozen event-time mean, for upper and lower extremes alike.
preregistered_structural_law.causal_timing: The event, center, and scale use only the 12 completed closes ending at t; the outcome uses only close at t+12 and the event-time center and scale.
preregistered_structural_law.independence: Retain at most one eligible event per symbol per UTC date: the first extreme anchor with a complete exact-contiguous 12-bar forward window and nonzero event-time scale.
preregistered_structural_law.daily_statistic: For each retained event/date, report its standardized absolute-distance contraction.

inference.partition: Sort eligible UTC event dates chronologically; first floor(N/2) dates are half 1 and remaining dates are half 2.
inference.test: ONE_SIDED_EXACT_BINOMIAL_SIGN_TEST_OF_POSITIVE_STANDARDIZED_ABSOLUTE_DISTANCE_CONTRACTION; omit exact-zero outcomes from the sign-test denominator.
inference.raw_symbol_support: Both halves meet minimum date sufficiency, both sample medians are strictly positive, and both one-sided exact sign-test p-values are at most 0.05.
inference.symbol_family: Fixed family of all 41 current structural representatives; insufficient symbols remain in the family with p-value 1.

preregistered_structural_law.missing_data: No fill, interpolation, resampling, or synthetic bars. Any timestamp delta other than exactly 300 seconds invalidates a window that crosses it. Missing, invalid, non-contiguous, or zero-scale event windows are excluded, not repaired.
preregistered_structural_law.input_validation: Require exact accepted archive hashes, M5 manifests, the frozen 41-symbol registry split (38 development and 3 replacements), matching series identities and member hashes, finite positive OHLC, valid OHLC bounds, UTC timestamps within the accepted interval, and no synthetic or forward fill.
